name: Stone Brewing Tap Room
notes: This is the Kettner taproom, distinct from Stone Brewing World Bistro & Gardens (Escondido/Liberty Station), which does have a priced food menu. The Kettner location's own site (checked in full) lists only beer names/styles/ABV, hours and location, no food menu and no beer prices. Web search corroborates: this taproom has no in-house kitchen ('no food at this Stone Brewery location, just good beer'); food comes from rotating third-party food-truck/pop-up vendors and outside food is explicitly welcome, so no restaurant-published food menu exists. No per-item beer pricing was found published anywhere either (typical for a taproom pouring flights/pints rather than an itemized beer-and-price board). No ordering platform (Toast/Square/etc.) link on the site.

Found a dated photo of the truck's own physical price board via sagemenu.com's photo gallery (alt text 'the menu for the restaurant') and read it directly as an image. The board has several prices on price-sticker overlays (Taco Dorado, Quesa Taco, Keto Taco) suggesting a recent update. Dropped one item ('Orden' / full-size Birria en Caldo) because its price on the board was visually ambiguous (partly obscured) and could not be read with confidence - only the clearly legible 'Media Orden' (half order) at $9.50 was kept. Multi-line combo items (Quesa Birria, Burrito, Combo Birria, Deluxe Combo) had their description line paired with the single price shown at the same board row; this pairing is a good-faith read of a single photo, not verified against a second source.
